_comment_workspaces: apps/_web-paused is deliberately absent. It was matched by an apps/* glob, which kept the paused website installing, typechecking, linting and testing on every command. Naming the workspaces means pausing an app actually pauses it. Restoring the website is: rename the folder back and add it here.
